contactHeading: Tell me what you want to make and I will tell you how I would shoot it.
tagline: Photographer and filmmaker based in Amsterdam.
aboutThree: I work with brands, artists and agencies across Europe, usually from concept through to the final grade.
aboutIntro: I am Marijn-Sohail Chaouch, a photographer and filmmaker based in Amsterdam. I make photos and videos inside one concept, so a campaign holds together across every frame instead of falling apart between the photo and the film.
aboutTwo: Trained at Fotoacademie Amsterdam, with a Moroccan and Dutch background that keeps showing up in how I look at light and people. The work is cinematic and driven by story.
